name: Dual SMA Crossover Strategy - USD/CHF
description: Multi-timeframe moving average crossover strategy on USD/CHF. Uses daily SMAs (20/50/200) displayed on 1-hour chart. Two independent signals: 20×50 cross (1 contract) and 20×200 cross (2 contracts). Positions accumulate when both signals align.
source:
# USD/CHF Dual SMA Crossover Strategy
# Two independent crossover signals with position accumulation
# Signal 1: 20-day × 50-day SMA → 1 contract
# Signal 2: 20-day × 200-day SMA → 2 contracts
# Positions accumulate when both signals align

# =============================================================================
# DATA SOURCE - Daily for SMA calculations
# =============================================================================
src_daily = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
close_daily = src_daily.c

# =============================================================================
# DAILY SMAs (20, 50, 200 trading days)
# =============================================================================
sma_20 = ma(period=20, type=MAType.sma)(close_daily)
sma_50 = ma(period=50, type=MAType.sma)(close_daily)
sma_200 = ma(period=200, type=MAType.sma)(close_daily)

# =============================================================================
# CROSSOVER DETECTION (on daily data to avoid hourly noise)
# =============================================================================

# Signal 1: 20×50 crossovers
cross_20_50_up = crossover(sma_20, sma_50)
cross_20_50_down = crossunder(sma_20, sma_50)

# Signal 2: 20×200 crossovers
cross_20_200_up = crossover(sma_20, sma_200)
cross_20_200_down = crossunder(sma_20, sma_200)

# =============================================================================
# HOLD SIGNALS (until next crossover in any direction)
# =============================================================================

# 20×50 signal: hold long or short until opposite cross
held_20_50_long = hold_until()(enter=cross_20_50_up, exit=cross_20_50_down)
held_20_50_short = hold_until()(enter=cross_20_50_down, exit=cross_20_50_up)

# 20×200 signal: hold long or short until opposite cross
held_20_200_long = hold_until()(enter=cross_20_200_up, exit=cross_20_200_down)
held_20_200_short = hold_until()(enter=cross_20_200_down, exit=cross_20_200_up)

# =============================================================================
# COMPUTE NET POSITION SIGNAL
# =============================================================================

# Convert held signals to directional values
# 20×50: +1 for long, -1 for short, 0 for flat
signal_20_50 = 1 if held_20_50_long else -1 if held_20_50_short else 0

# 20×200: +2 for long, -2 for short, 0 for flat
signal_20_200 = 2 if held_20_200_long else -2 if held_20_200_short else 0

# Net position signal (can range from -3 to +3)
net_signal = signal_20_50 + signal_20_200

# =============================================================================
# UPSAMPLE TO HOURLY TIMEFRAME (forward-fill to propagate daily signals)
# =============================================================================
net_signal_1h = upsample_by_interpolate(target_timeframe=1H)(net_signal)

# =============================================================================
# ENTRY/EXIT LOGIC
# =============================================================================
long_entry_1h = net_signal_1h > 0
short_entry_1h = net_signal_1h < 0

# Execute strategy
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=long_entry_1h, short_entry=short_entry_1h)

# =============================================================================
# POSITION SIZING (absolute value of net signal = contract count)
# =============================================================================
position_contracts = abs(net_signal_1h)
position_size(type=SizeType.unit)(size=position_contracts)
